units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 13:6:2">Y. Sabb. XIII, end, 14ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>ולהעלות נ׳ של דגים וכ׳</he> and to bring up a basket of fish with the child; (<cite ref="Menachot 64a">Men. 64ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="M02281"><he>מצודה</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: bee-hive, also the bees of a hive, swarm.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:2:5">Y. Sabb. IV, 7ᵃ</cite> top <he>נ׳ של דבורין</he> (Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 43a:14">ib. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>כוורת</he>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:1:5">Y. Bets. V, beg. 62ᵈ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:2">B. Kam. X, 2</cite> <he>מכאן יצא נ׳ זה</he> this swarm came from here.

<cite ref="Tosefta Moed Kattan 1:6">Tosef. M. Kat. I, 6</cite> <he>נחול דבורים שברח וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>נחיל</he>) a swarm of bees that flew away may be brought back (during the festive week); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="N01041"><he>נְחִילִים</he></cite>, <he>נְחִילִין</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:3">B. Bath. V, 3</cite> <he>פירות כוורת נוטל שלשה נ׳ וכ׳</he> he who buys the issue (bees) of a bee-hive takes three swarms of young bees &c., v. <cite ref="O01646"><he>סָרַס</he></cite>.
